en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, steam-powered boats travel along a broad river with quays and warehouses on the near bank. Above the town's roofs rises a large castle-like building with towers and, behind it, a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Meißen on the Elbe River with Albrechtsburg Castle and the cathedral (Dom).
